description: Queue AI translation, in one call, for every sequence email (including sequence A/B variants) and enabled transactional email that has no translation in a language yet or whose last translation failed. It also translates sequence push steps (not archived, not defined in code) missing a language. Translations someone edited, up-to-date ones and outdated ones are left alone; use sync_template_localizations on one template to retranslate it. Omit `locales` for every enabled non-primary locale. Adding a language in the dashboard already does this for that language. Translations run in the background; follow them with get_template_localization_coverage.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

locales.description: Optional enabled non-primary locale codes to translate into. Omit for every enabled non-primary locale.

name: translate_missing_template_localizations

queuedEmails.description: Emails with at least one translation queued.
